Package org.example.model

Class SimulationRun

java.lang.Object
org.example.model.SimulationRun
public class SimulationRun extends Object
Model entity representing an overall simulation run summary record stored in the simulation_runs database table.

Encapsulates high-level performance metrics recorded upon simulation completion, including total execution duration, customer volume breakdown (takeaway, dine-in, online), average customer stay duration, and resource utilization rates.

    • SimulationRun

      public SimulationRun(double simulationTime, int totalCustomers, double averageStayTime, int takeawayCount, int dineinCount, int onlineCount, double oven1Utilization, double oven2Utilization)
      Parameterized constructor for instantiating a new simulation run entity prior to database insertion.
      Parameters:
      simulationTime - Total time duration of the simulation run.
      totalCustomers - Total number of processed customers.
      averageStayTime - Average duration spent by customers in the system.
      takeawayCount - Total takeaway customer count.
      dineinCount - Total dine-in customer count.
      onlineCount - Total online delivery customer count.
      oven1Utilization - Station utilization rate for Oven 1.
      oven2Utilization - Station utilization rate for Oven 2.
